path.description: Sends a leaf `shopping_domain_search` answered, or a kind to list its leaves. One that does not stand answers `not_found`; a shelf, domain or top answers `not_a_leaf` naming leaves under it; an area sil does not carry yet answers `not_carried`.

keys.description: Sends keys of this place, from its index, to read only those whole — each with its `description` and `step`. Absent: the index of every key. A key the place has no spec for is refused. Not with `after`.

after.description: Sends the `next` of the page just read, to read the index on from that key; a key the place has no spec for is refused.
